name: ES Counterfactual Auction Displacement v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: The difference between the real volume-weighted opening center and the center created by the identical price path under equal minute volume isolates where urgent inventory was disproportionately transferred. Price should subsequently move away from the side where excess volume was absorbed.

counterfactual.observed_center: volume-weighted mean of the 30 one-minute typical prices
counterfactual.neutral_center: unweighted arithmetic mean of the same 30 typical prices, equivalent to assigning equal volume to every minute
counterfactual.long_signal: displacement < 0, meaning actual volume concentrated the clearing center below its equal-volume counterfactual
counterfactual.short_signal: displacement > 0, meaning actual volume concentrated the clearing center above its equal-volume counterfactual
counterfactual.zero_rule: no trade when displacement equals zero
counterfactual.interpretation: trade away from the side where disproportionate opening inventory was transferred

execution.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.stop_fill: one adverse ES tick beyond the applicable opening extreme
execution.entry_validity: skip if the frozen stop fill is not adverse to the simulated entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 10:00 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.gap_through_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the trigger, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick; otherwise fill at the frozen stop price
execution.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: Actual opening volume placement relative to an equal-volume counterfactual contained weak aggregate information, but it failed in 2023 and on shorts. The long and pre-2023 effects cannot be selected post hoc. Alternative counterfactual assignments or direction reversal are prohibited for this family.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: trading toward rather than away from observed volume concentration
changing equal-volume assignment to reversed, ranked, shuffled, or historical volume
adding price direction or closing-location confirmation
weekday, volatility, volume, or regime filters
changing the stop or exit after observing results
